requirements.title: Registration and email verification
requirements.flow: Normalize email; create ACTIVE unverified user and PASSENGER role; enqueue OTP; consume correct OTP atomically
requirements.alt: Existing email receives generic acknowledgement; resend replaces prior code
requirements.errors: Invalid body 422; bad/expired code 400; attempt/resend limit 429
requirements.post: Email verified once; no duplicate account
requirements.accept: A correct OTP works once; sixth wrong attempt cannot verify; no ADMIN input accepted

requirements.title: Login and logout
requirements.flow: Check Argon2id; issue 15-minute access JWT and opaque refresh cookie; logout revokes family
requirements.alt: Bad email/password share error; repeated logout succeeds
requirements.errors: Invalid credentials 401; unverified/suspended 403; rate limit 429
requirements.post: Session tracked; logged-out access rejected by family check
requirements.accept: Cookie HttpOnly/Secure in staging/prod; token never localStorage; logout token fails next API request

requirements.title: Rotating refresh and session controls
requirements.flow: Lock token; consume; issue one successor with fixed family absolute expiry; list/revoke own sessions
requirements.alt: Token reuse revokes family; client serializes refresh across tabs
requirements.errors: Missing/reused/expired cookie 401; invalid Origin 403; foreign family 404
requirements.post: At most one rotation succeeds; revoked session immediately unusable
requirements.accept: Two refreshes with same token cannot both succeed; replay invalidates successor; family age never exceeds30d

requirements.title: Password reset
requirements.pre: Existing verified account, but response does not reveal it
requirements.flow: Queue 256-bit reset link; consume hash under lock within15min; replace password; revoke all sessions
requirements.alt: Unknown email acknowledges identically; newer request invalidates prior link
requirements.errors: Bad/reused/expired token400; weak password422; limit429
requirements.post: No prior refresh or access token works
requirements.accept: One reset token succeeds once; login with old password fails; secrets absent logs

requirements.title: Profile and multiple roles
requirements.flow: Keep PASSENGER; add role idempotently; create draft onboarding profile; role union grants navigation, never approval
requirements.alt: Account may hold PASSENGER+DRIVER+OWNER+ADMIN; UI role switch changes context only
requirements.errors: ADMIN grant request422; foreign profile404; invalid phone422
requirements.post: Unique user-role rows; operational verification unchanged
requirements.accept: Repeated addRole creates one row; role switch does not alter token authority; backend ownership tested

requirements.title: Driver profile, documents and submission
requirements.pre: Verified active email and DRIVER role
requirements.flow: Persist license details; upload/quarantine; submit clean license revision with expiry and immutable document references
requirements.alt: Rejected revision can be corrected and resubmitted; pending duplicate returns409
requirements.errors: Bad upload415/413; expired license422; missing doc422
requirements.post: Pending revision does not confer booking eligibility
requirements.accept: Unverified driver absent public search and cannot accept/host; two simultaneous submissions yield one pending

requirements.title: Driver approval lifecycle
requirements.pre: Pending current revision; admin not subject
requirements.flow: Validate clean current unexpired snapshot; CAS status; record actor/reason; emit event
requirements.alt: Material identity edit invalidates prior approval; expiry worker disables eligibility
requirements.errors: Stale revision409; self approval403; expired docs422
requirements.post: Only APPROVED unexpired profile eligible
requirements.accept: Outdated approval request cannot approve replacement license; expired driver blocked even if expiry job paused

requirements.title: Driver availability and history
requirements.pre: Own profile; approval needed to list
requirements.flow: Store explicit UTC AVAILABLE/BLOCKED windows; reserve blocks; public hire needs full window; list self requests
requirements.alt: Disable listing preserves accepted work; self-drive/host need no hire window
requirements.errors: Overlap409; remove window uncovering holds409
requirements.post: No double use across hire/carpool/block
requirements.accept: Booking against driver BLOCKED interval fails; touching [start,end) intervals succeed

requirements.title: Owner and vehicle registration
requirements.flow: Normalize unique registration; set DRAFT; upload clean registration/insurance/image; submit immutable revision
requirements.alt: Owner may own many vehicles; archived registrations remain reserved
requirements.errors: Foreign vehicle404; duplicate registration409; invalid capacity422
requirements.post: Owner relationship immutable; private documents protected
requirements.accept: Cross-owner edit/read/download denied; no unverified public listing

requirements.title: Vehicle verification and expiry
requirements.flow: Review registration and insurance; approve current revision; compute eligibility through document dates on every write
requirements.alt: Material vehicle edits need new approval; price edits affect new quotes only
requirements.errors: Own verification403; stale version409; expired insurance422
requirements.post: Only valid approved vehicles can be booked/published
requirements.accept: Approved but expired insurance cannot create quote/booking; rejected reason visible owner only

requirements.title: Vehicle availability, safe archive and history
requirements.flow: Require explicit hire window; blocks use shared reservations; prohibit archival with live commitments; retain history
requirements.alt: Unlist affects discovery/new commitments only; bookings/history remain accessible
requirements.errors: Conflicting block409; archive with pending/future/active trip409
requirements.post: Archived vehicle absent discovery and new bookings
requirements.accept: History/reviews remain after archive; block cannot overlap host carpool

requirements.title: Search and quotes for three service modes
requirements.pre: Verified user; resources satisfy mode rules
requirements.flow: Filter listings by city/category/seats/time; server prices rounded-up hours; issue owned10min quote snapshot
requirements.alt: Search results do not hold inventory; self-drive uses approved requester driver; DRIVER_HIRE uses requester-owned verified vehicle
requirements.errors: Past/invalid date422; ineligible resources409; fabricated price rejected422
requirements.post: Quote specifies modes, rates, total and NOT_COLLECTED
requirements.accept: Changing client total cannot change persisted price; quote after10min rejected; own vehicle rental rejected

requirements.title: Atomic booking creation and idempotency
requirements.pre: Owned valid quote, lead>=60min, available resources
requirements.flow: Lock accounts/resources; revalidate eligibility/versions; reserve both driver/vehicle; create PENDING booking, decisions, SCHEDULED trip, events and idempotency result in one transaction
requirements.alt: Same key/body replays same result24h; new quote needed if rates changed
requirements.errors: Conflict409; key payload mismatch409; expired quote409
requirements.post: No partial resource holds or orphan trip
requirements.accept: Concurrent overlapping booking/carpool/block commits at most one; injected failure rolls back all writes

requirements.title: Provider consent and assignment
requirements.flow: Record required owner consent for rental, driver consent for driver hire, both for combined; last acceptance confirms and assigns trip
requirements.alt: Pending replacement driver atomically swaps hold and resets driver consent; no deadline extension
requirements.errors: Nonprovider403/404; stale decision409; ineligible resource409
requirements.post: All approvals required before CONFIRMED/ASSIGNED; rejection releases holds
requirements.accept: Combined one approval stays PENDING; simultaneous final decisions produce one confirmation event

requirements.title: Cancellation, rejection and expiry
requirements.flow: Lock booking; validate version/cutoff; terminalize booking and trip; release reservations; emit participant notifications
requirements.alt: Requester confirmed cutoff15min; provider cancellation allowed before start with reason; overdue pending worker expires
requirements.errors: After start409; missing reason422; unauthorized404
requirements.post: Terminal outcomes immutable; no refund/payment claims
requirements.accept: Cancel twice cannot release unrelated holds; delayed worker cannot permit accept after deadline

requirements.title: Host draft and publication
requirements.pre: Approved host driver and owned approved vehicle
requirements.flow: Store exact city pair, notes, times, seats and join mode; publish acquires same dual reservation as DriveHire; trip becomes ASSIGNED
requirements.alt: DRAFT holds no resources; published route/seat/price edits forbidden; cancel and recreate
requirements.errors: Foreign vehicle404; seats>vehicle.seats-1 422; overlap409
requirements.post: Published capacity excludes driver and is immutable
requirements.accept: Driver-only role cannot host without owned verified vehicle; published ride conflicts with hire reservation

requirements.title: Carpool search and detail
requirements.pre: Published eligible ride before join cutoff
requirements.flow: Use city IDs; interpret date in origin timezone; return published rides with enough remaining seats and unexpired resources
requirements.alt: Full ride remains reachable by detail but absent seats>=1 search; drafts private
requirements.errors: Invalid date/seats422; private ride404
requirements.post: No exact-location/GPS implication
requirements.accept: Day boundary search includes correct UTC intervals; roster/contact absent public response

requirements.title: Seat request and instant join
requirements.pre: Verified active non-host; published ride >=15min before departure
requirements.flow: Lock carpool; create PENDING request for approval or ACCEPTED request + increment confirmedSeats for instant; store seat-price snapshot
requirements.alt: Pending requests consume no seats; existing live request409; user may request again after cancellation
requirements.errors: Not enough seats409; self join403; request after cutoff409
requirements.post: Available=offered-confirmed; never negative
requirements.accept: Many concurrent joins for final seat yield one ACCEPTED; idempotent retry consumes seats once

requirements.title: Host accept/reject requests
requirements.pre: Own published ride; PENDING request; >=15min before start
requirements.flow: Lock ride then request; validate request version; accept checks capacity and increments counter atomically; reject changes request only
requirements.alt: Request may already be cancelled; host must reload; full ride can reject remaining requests
requirements.errors: Foreign host404; stale/capacity409; reason on rejection422
requirements.post: Accepted passengers visible only host/participants where authorized
requirements.accept: Two accepts for final seat cannot both succeed; accepted request cannot be accepted again

requirements.title: Passenger cancellation and host cancellation
requirements.flow: Accepted cancellation restores seats once; pending cancellation changes no counter; ride cancellation cancels live requests, resets confirmedSeats, releases resources
requirements.alt: Pending requests expire at join cutoff; published unstarted ride expires30min after scheduled start; accepted no-show remains participant/history
requirements.errors: After start requester409; stale version409; unauthorized404
requirements.post: No seat count drift; affected users notified
requirements.accept: Race accept/cancel serializes; host cancellation plus passenger cancellation never produces negative count

requirements.title: Authorized lifecycle and history
requirements.flow: Follow SCHEDULED->ASSIGNED->STARTED->IN_TRANSIT->COMPLETED; lock resources and trip; CAS version; append history and outbox; sync parent
requirements.alt: FAILED by driver/admin with reason; cancellation/rejection/expiry prior to start; late starts expire after30min
requirements.errors: Skipped/backward/terminal409; passenger advance403
requirements.post: One immutable event/history per transition; parent state consistent
requirements.accept: SCHEDULED cannot start; two same-version transitions commit once; completion releases reservations and updates parent

requirements.title: Simulated route and operational overruns
requirements.trigger: Advance marker or inspect overdue trip
requirements.flow: Persist manual waypoint index; label simulation; forbid start if resource still in any other STARTED/IN_TRANSIT trip; flag overrun
requirements.alt: Admin resolves upcoming conflict by cancellation/reassignment before resources start; never auto-complete or invent location
requirements.errors: Advance at end409; stale version409; non-driver403
requirements.post: Progress monotone; no real GPS or computed live ETA
requirements.accept: Overrunning earlier ride blocks next ride start even after scheduled interval ends; marker accessible text

requirements.title: Eligible ratings and duplicate prevention
requirements.flow: Validate participation and target; prevent reviewing self/own vehicle; save rating1..5 and plain text; unique target per author/trip
requirements.alt: Rental requester rates vehicle only; driver hire requester rates hired driver only; combined/carpool can rate both
requirements.errors: Uncompleted/foreign target403/404; duplicate409; invalid rating422
requirements.post: Public aggregate reflects visible eligible reviews only
requirements.accept: Parallel duplicate submissions create one review; hidden review removed from count/mean immediately

requirements.title: Reliable database notifications
requirements.flow: Write outbox in domain transaction; worker fans out typed notification records with unique event-recipient key; poll unread feed
requirements.alt: Worker crash replays safely; email failures independent of in-app delivery
requirements.errors: Unauthorized recipient read404; DB write failure leaves retryable event
requirements.post: Persistent notification delivery despite process restart
requirements.accept: Crash after one recipient insert and retry yields exactly one notification per recipient within60s healthy worker

requirements.title: User suspension/reactivation
requirements.pre: Active admin; target not self/last active admin
requirements.flow: Revoke token/session access immediately; remove listings; atomically cancel unstarted commitments; flag started trips incident; audit and notify
requirements.alt: Reactivation does not renew verification, restore sessions or reinstate cancelled bookings
requirements.errors: Self/last admin409; nonadmin403; absent reason422
requirements.post: Suspended account cannot mutate/read protected APIs; history preserved
requirements.accept: Already issued JWT blocked next request; active driver incident visible for admin resolution; reactivation needs fresh login

requirements.title: Operational booking/carpool/trip management
requirements.trigger: Inspect queues, cancel unstarted, fail incident trip
requirements.flow: Use same domain services as participant APIs with audited override policy; never patch arbitrary state
requirements.alt: Replacement only pending; confirmed change cancel/rebook; active incident FAILED allowed
requirements.errors: Invalid transition409; nonadmin403
requirements.post: Admin cannot bypass resource overlap or seat constraints
requirements.accept: Admin cancellation shares rollback behavior; every intervention includes reason and requestId

requirements.title: Complaints and moderation
requirements.pre: Trip participant to complain; ADMIN to decide
requirements.flow: Persist own complaint; admin queue OPEN->IN_REVIEW->RESOLVED/DISMISSED with reason; notify reporter; hide abusive review with audit
requirements.alt: Duplicate abuse capped3 open/user/trip; terminal complaint immutable
requirements.errors: Foreign trip404; invalid transition409; missing resolution422
requirements.post: Case and action history retained; public abusive review hidden
requirements.accept: Nonadmin cannot decide; resolution/notification/audit commit atomically

requirements.title: Reports and immutable audit trail
requirements.pre: Active role and bounded date range
requirements.flow: Return operational counts and estimated value; append reasoned admin mutation audits and sensitive document/user read audits
requirements.alt: No collected-revenue language; report UTC [from,to) with max90day span
requirements.errors: Excessive range422; nonadmin403; mutation of audit unsupported
requirements.post: No secrets in immutable audit payloads
requirements.accept: Report counts match seeded database; hidden review excluded rating; app DB role cannot UPDATE/DELETE audit rows

requirements.title: Private uploads and file lifecycle
requirements.pre: Authorized subject and allowed document kind
requirements.flow: Limit5MiB; magic-byte allowlist JPEG/PNG/WebP/PDF; random storage key; scan private quarantine; stream clean authorized file; re-encode images strip metadata
requirements.alt: Local private disk+scanner and durable object-storage adapter share contract; pending scan blocks submission
requirements.errors: Oversize413; invalid MIME415; foreign document404; malware422
requirements.post: No public private-file URL or path traversal; orphan cleanup30min
requirements.accept: SVG/HTML spoof rejected; public image cannot expose license; referenced approved doc cannot be removed

requirements.title: Health, deployment and recoverability
requirements.flow: Validate env; migration release job; drain HTTP/worker; health/ready probes; durable storage; backup and restore rehearsal
requirements.alt: Worker retry and clean restart maintain domain correctness; demo data isolated
requirements.errors: Readiness503 on DB/schema/worker failure; refuse prod seed
requirements.post: Reproducible deploy; schema/extensions supported; backups restored
requirements.accept: Fresh DB applies migrations incl exclusion constraints; production build boots; restore reconciles reservations/seats/outbox
